# Threat model: super-agent monorepo (/workspace/agentcore-superagent-update)

## Overview
Super Agent is an enterprise multi-tenant AI-agent platform: business users author SOPs, spawn agents, and wire them into workflows. Repo layout (all paths relative to `super-agent/`):

- `frontend/` — React 19 + Vite SPA (299 src files), Supabase JS dependency (unused at runtime), react-markdown/react-router. Browser-side rendering of agent/AI output.
- `backend/` — Fastify 5 TypeScript API (250 src files): `routes/` (50 modules), `authorization/` (roles/permissions/agentAccess/scopeAccess), `middleware/auth.ts` (Cognito aws-jwt-verify + local JWT + internal HMAC tokens), `websocket/execution.gateway.ts`, Prisma + Postgres, Redis/BullMQ, S3, Swagger UI, websocket chat.
- `agentcore/` — Bedrock AgentCore runtime package + Dockerfile (runs as `node`, workspace synced to/from S3).
- `infra/` — AWS CDK stack + EC2 user-data provisioning and deploy/CI scripts.
- `app-hosting/poc/` — docker-compose + CDK PoC scripts (docker.sock mounts, Traefik, per-tenant services).
- `industry-packs/` — 15 YAML/marketing content packs.
- `document/`, `images/` — docs.

Deployment model (observed in code): dual auth mode — Cognito JWT (production) or local JWT (dev/`.env`); SPA in browser ↔ Fastify API on an EC2 host (nginx + backend per user-data.sh); backend reaches Bedrock, S3, Postgres, Redis. Multi-tenant with an organization-based authorization layer.

## Trust Boundaries and Assumptions (confirmed by assessment)
- **Browser ↔ SPA**: tokens (Cognito or local JWT) stored in localStorage. Agent-generated preview apps run in iframes with `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"` pointing at the API origin that accepts `?token=` — sandbox nullified (reported). OAuth postMessage handler has no origin check (reported). react-markdown/highlight.js rendering verified escaping by default; xlsx parse of attacker spreadsheets is prototype-pollution reachable (reported, dependency CVE).
- **SPA ↔ Backend**: frontend role gating has matching backend enforcement on sampled routes; the real gaps are backend-side (below). Bearer-token auth only, no cookies (limits CORS impact despite wildcard default).
- **Anonymous → Backend (CONFIRMED weak)**: `/ws/executions` WebSocket has no authentication and no per-execution ownership check; avatar generate/proxy endpoints unauthenticated; public webhook trigger (`/v1/webhook/:id/trigger`) has no auth/HMAC/replay; generic IM webhook processes unsigned requests; `GET /api/auth/config` discloses the Cognito userPoolId used as the internal-token HMAC key (auth forgery, reported critical).
- **Tenant ↔ Tenant (CONFIRMED weak)**: knowledge-base, briefing, and scope plugin/MCP-server lookups lack `organization_id` scoping (cross-org IDOR, reported); agentAccess explicit-permission lookup ignores org scoping; workflow execution events broadcast to any WS subscriber.
- **Org member → Backend host (CONFIRMED critical)**: workflow custom-transform nodes eval attacker-authored expressions unsandboxed (`action-executor.ts` applyCustomTransform) — authenticated RCE for any 'member'; API-call nodes fetch arbitrary URLs with response readback (SSRF, reported); a second eval sink in code-artifact-executor is blocked only by an incidental SyntaxError.
- **Deployment/CI → Runtime**: seed admin password `Admin1234!` written and logged by deploy scripts; hardcoded Redis password; JWT_SECRET unset on the CI env path (falls back to backend default secret); PoC stack ships docker.sock mounts and hardcoded tenant JWT secrets (all reported).
- **Backend ↔ agentcore**: backend writes an API key into the agentcore process env; workspace sync to/from S3 lacks path containment (`workspace-sync.ts`) — traversal confirmed locally, tenant-reachable write primitive not found (open proof gap).

Assumptions: live AWS deployment out of scope (local-only validation with mocks). Production exposure of reported code paths is unverified; each report states this in assumptions.

## Attack Surface and Attacker Stories
| Actor | Starting access | Path (confirmed) | Impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| Authenticated org member | Any member account | eval() in custom transform node (`execution.routes.ts:154` → `action-executor.ts:316-325`) | Backend host RCE (vuln-0025) |
| Authenticated user | Any account | KB/briefing/scope-plugin routes without org scoping | Cross-org data read/write/delete (vuln-0004) |
| Anonymous | Network reachability | `/ws/executions` subscribe; public webhook trigger; IM webhook; avatar endpoints | Cross-tenant events, workflow/agent abuse, cost DoS (vuln-0026/0009/0011/0013) |
| Anonymous | Read public repo/config | userPoolId-disclosure internal-token forgery; default JWT secret; seed admin password | Full auth bypass / admin login (vuln-0006, vuln-0005) |
| Authenticated member | Workflow authorship | API node fetch with readback (`action-executor.ts:123`) | SSRF incl. cloud metadata (vuln-0028) |
| Victim browser | Visits attacker page / opens SPA | ConnectorPanel postMessage without origin check | Connector credential binding hijack (vuln-0001) |

Unrealistic: attacking the live AWS environment (out of scope); requiring admin as a precondition for the member-reachable findings; skill-marketplace SSRF (ruled out: github.com hostname guard); credentialed-CORS exploitation (no cookies); SQL injection (all raw SQL parameterized — ruled out); applyFilter/applyReduce evals (unreachable — ruled out).

## Severity Calibration (as applied)
- **Critical**: member-reachable eval RCE; auth-forgery family; seed admin password in deploy path.
- **High**: cross-org IDOR; unauth webhook/IM-webhook execution; ws DoS CVE on unauth gateway.
- **Medium**: SSRF with readback; unauth WS subscription; path traversal families; postMessage origin bypass; sandbox-nullified iframes; avatar endpoints; MCP-SDK OAuth redirection.
- **Low/Info**: token-in-URL; xlsx PP/ReDoS (low reachability); not_reachable dependency CVEs (documented with exclusion traces).

## Assessment Coverage Notes
28 vulnerability reports filed (3 critical, 6 high, 9 medium, 3 low, 7 info) across 65 coverage entries (34 reported / 18 no-issue / 5 ruled-out / 2 needs_follow_up + residual). Remaining open proof gaps: agentcore AUTH_TOKEN/workspace persistence across container reuse (platform lifecycle not determinable from repo); app-hosting/poc fastify 4.x unpatchable line (remediation is an upgrade). Clean areas: raw SQL fully parameterized; files.routes S3 prefix enforcement; workflow/document org scoping; Cognito JWT verification itself; no secrets in frontend; no install scripts; CDK buckets private/encrypted.
